# Getting help

| You want to …                                 | Go to                                                                                                                                |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Learn how to install, configure or use Marmot | [Documentation](https://github.com/ThinkHumanDotDev/marmot/blob/main/docs/Home.md)                                                   |
| Ask a question                                | [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/ThinkHumanDotDev/marmot/discussions/categories/q-a)                                           |
| Suggest or discuss an idea                    | [Discussions → Ideas](https://github.com/ThinkHumanDotDev/marmot/discussions/categories/ideas)                                       |
| Share something you built                     | [Discussions → Show and tell](https://github.com/ThinkHumanDotDev/marmot/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)                       |
| Report a bug or request a scoped feature      | [Issues](https://github.com/ThinkHumanDotDev/marmot/issues/new/choose)                                                               |
| Report a security vulnerability               | [Private security advisory](https://github.com/ThinkHumanDotDev/marmot/security/advisories/new), see [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) |

Before asking, search existing discussions and issues. In Q&A, include your Marmot version, database adapter,
deployment method and relevant logs with secrets removed; the form asks for them. Mark the answer that solved
your question so others can find it.
